title: Pro-etale Tor amplitude and bounded flat model
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, let X be a scheme, let a b : ℤ with a ≤ b, and let K be an object of the derived category of sheaves of A-modules on the small pro-etale site of X such that K is bounded constructible. Then K has Tor amplitude in [a,b] if and only if there exists a cochain complex P of such sheaves with every term flat, with P^q zero for q outside [a,b], and with K isomorphic to the image of P in the derived category. Here the site and bounded constructibility are as in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], and Tor amplitude is [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude].
